description: Market at Round Rock is a thriving 122,946 square foot community shopping center strategically positioned at a high-traffic intersection along Interstate 35 in Round Rock, Texas, one of the fastest-growing areas in the state. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, this open-air retail destination serves the prosperous Austin-Round Rock metropolitan area with a carefully curated mix of essential retailers and services. The center is anchored by key tenants including Sprouts Farmers Market, Office Depot, and Party Chaos, providing shoppers with grocery, office supplies, and specialty retail options all in one convenient location. With over 1.4 million annual visits, Market at Round Rock has established itself as a go-to destination for the area's affluent residents, who enjoy an average household income of $123,378 within three miles. The center's prime location along I-35 ensures excellent visibility and accessibility for the growing population of Round Rock and surrounding communities, making it an integral part of the local retail landscape.
